Basic chat completion via the Anthropic provider (claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022) with system and user messages

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"max_tokens\":16,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"You are a helpful assistant.\",\"role\":\"system\"},{\"content\":\"Say hello in one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022\",\"temperature\":0}")
    result = await client.chat(req)
    print(result.choices)
    print(result.choices[0].message.content)
    print(result.choices[0].finish_reason)
    print(result.model)
    print(result.usage.total_tokens)

asyncio.run(main())
```
